authors.bio: A. A. J. Franken, born in the Netherlands, studied physics and electronics at the University of Amsterdam, where he received his Ph.D. in 1965. Two years later he joined the Medical Systems Division of N.V. Philips' Gloeilampenfabrieken, where he specialized in X-ray image intensifier television systems. Since 1976 he has worked in the Development and Application Group, specializing in television pickup tubes.
